items.title: Warehouse check: read-only receipts feed for the Hub (XB)
items.meta: 24 Nov · Max: "put it on live now" · built on the live Order Queue build ae404ef4 · NOT on staging yet
items.desc: Adds ONE read-only address, GET /api/hub-feed/receipts, so the Hub's Bills > Warehouse check can compare billed weight with what was scanned in. Answers only with the Hub's secret token; never writes; no prices, values, notes or driver fields. Live has no Hub feed today (404). After the code moves, the feed stays OFF until HUB_FEED_TOKEN (32+ characters) and HUB_FEED_SOURCE=nextrade-live are set in live .env by Max (the release system never touches .env), and the Hub reads it only once Max sets NEXTRADE_RECEIPTS_URL, NEXTRADE_RECEIPTS_TOKEN (the same secret) and NEXTRADE_RECEIPTS_ALLOW_LIVE=yes in Vercel (Hub v55.83-YT). The shared NEXTRADE_FEED_URL (Orders report, shipping sync) stays on staging and must NOT be switched to this receipts-only live copy.
items.backup: made by the release worker before replacement (routes/api.php, config/services.php); the new controller is moved aside on rollback
items.rollback: Change Schedule roll back: restores the two files, moves the new controller aside; php artisan route:clear / config:clear
releaseSteps: Staging first: the same read-only method on fix staging (Nextrade chat, on Max's own yes), with the staging lock letting exactly /api/hub-feed/receipts through, and a behavioural check by id and by reference.
Confirm the two live "before" fingerprints read-only (they are the 14 Nov baseline in CRLF, not yet measured on the server).
Move the exact three files; php artisan route:clear and config:clear.
Without the .env token the address answers 401 to everyone (feed off). Max sets HUB_FEED_TOKEN and HUB_FEED_SOURCE=nextrade-live in live .env himself, then config:clear.
Check: no token = 401 JSON; with token, ?ids=<real scan-in id> = 200 with that receipt whole; ?ids=999999999 = not_found_ids.

protocol: Works on staging → Codex passes it → you name the change ("yes, put X on production").
Back up first — the exact files to ~/code-backups/<topic>-<date>/ and any data to a zz_<topic>_<table>_before_<date> table (never dropped).
Deploy the build, clear caches, verify the change and that nothing breaks.
Rollback if needed = restore those backups + clear caches. Data is never deleted, and rolling back code never touches the database — so no order, scan or bond row is ever lost.
protocolNote: Your go can be given on this screen (Sign off) or in chat; it is recorded for the exact build Codex passed. The move itself is done from the KTC office PC: backups first, each file checked, and an automatic restore if the site does not answer. A roll back restores the files saved just before the move. Until the automatic steps are switched on, each move is still done by hand in cPanel with the same backups.

deployAutomation.detail: The automatic move and undo steps are built and tested (v55.83-YJ) but switched off by two separate switches. Switching them on needs Codex's pass on those steps and Max naming it. Every move still needs Codex PASS + Max's go per change; data is never deleted and a roll back never touches the database.
